question: Did EXP-06 exhaust its proof budget while running the large vm.etch harness setup, before reaching the optimized verifier runtime?
affectedDecision: Whether Kontrol can plausibly be applied to representative optimized verifier code during design selection; this is not an FV-03 or FV-04 proof.
method: Read only the saved EXP-06 KCFG and record its edges, pending node, execution context, and code identity compactly.
Compare the same early-rejection test and pinned Kontrol/KEVM environment with the 7821-byte literal and a minimal reverting runtime stub. Change only the bytecode literal in the stub harness.
Compile the stub with the same solc 0.4.19 optimizer settings, run a concrete Foundry test, then cap each symbolic proof run at 90 seconds. Inspect the retained KCFG even when timed out.
comparisonLimit: The stub deliberately does not prove any property of RangeProofVerifier. It diagnoses setup cost only. The large case reuses the exact EXP-06 artifact; no new candidate verifier is implemented.

decision.setupBottleneckSupported: The large-case pending node remains in the test harness before a call to the verifier, while the stub case reaches its external call or terminates within the same bound.
decision.setupBottleneckNotEstablished: Both cases fail to reach their external call, or the result cannot be attributed to the changed runtime literal.
decision.notAFormalFeasibilityProof: Even a completed stub claim establishes no claim about the full verifier runtime or later proof obligations.
